## What's Changed

- Added read-only Explore connectors for VictoriaLogs, VictoriaMetrics, Prometheus, and Grafana Loki.
- Added Google BigQuery Standard SQL support with encrypted service-account credentials, schema discovery, native result pagination, and a 10-GiB billed-bytes cap per query job.
- Expanded datasource integration and setup guidance.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/InvestiGenie/investigenie/compare/0.2.0-alpha...0.3.0-alpha
